title: You made it!
description: The player falls into the desert and lies stunned, and the golden head lands beside him. YOU MADE IT! The final score counts up to the $21125 he brought out, the treasure adds $50000, and the time, kills and saves follow; the screen fades to black: YOU SHALL BE REMEMBERED AS A HERO.
